reversed_direction.question: Provide the names of individuals who have served as board members for companies based in Russia, along with the count of such companies for each person.
reversed_direction.pred:
MATCH (p:Person)-[r:hasBoardMember]->(c:Company)-[b:basedIn]->(country:Country {name: 'Russia'})
RETURN p.name AS board_member, COUNT(DISTINCT c) AS company_count
reversed_direction.gold: MATCH (n:Person)<-[r0:hasBoardMember]-(m0:Company)-[r1:basedIn]->(m1:Country {name: 'Russia'}) WITH n, count(DISTINCT m0) AS num RETURN n.name, num

reversed_direction.question: What are the names of individuals who have both founded a company and served on its board, but are not citizens of Austria?
reversed_direction.pred:
MATCH (p:Person)-[:foundedBy]->(c:Company)-[h:hasBoardMember]->(c)
WHERE NOT 'Austria' IN p.country_of_citizenship
RETURN DISTINCT p.name
reversed_direction.gold: MATCH (n:Person)<-[r0:foundedBy]-(m0:Company),(n:Person)<-[r1:hasBoardMember]-(m0:Company) WITH DISTINCT n WHERE NOT 'Austria' IN n.country_of_citizenship RETURN n.name
